reason: A is the stronger proposal because it specifies an annealing-controlled transformation pathway, measurable partitioning and precipitate morphology, service conditions, performance outcomes, and supporting observations from Mg-containing alloys. Its mechanism still needs correction—Ti/Zn-bearing precipitates may deplete rather than enrich the matrix, and >900 °C may exceed practical stability limits for some Mg-rich alloys—but B is more generic, lacks supporting evidence and quantitative boundaries, and does not clearly establish that quenching will create the proposed fine precipitates.
